reviews.tentative_bearing: definition subset adopted by C-378/14 paragraph26
reviews.note: Offermanns paragraph41 explains family-expense equalization as a public contribution to family budget reducing child-maintenance costs; paragraph27 uses purpose and granting conditions, paragraph28 statutory entitlement versus discretionary personal-need evaluation. Its operative inclusion of Austrian maintenance advances arose under Regulation1408/71, not current883/2004. The pinned883/2004 Article1(z) expressly excludes maintenance advances. Do not transpose Offermanns operative advance-inclusion into currentArticle1(z), or treat historical Austrian UVG amounts/nationality conditions as current German rates/eligibility. The general-definition passage is used in the retained Trapkowski judgment; the historical operative outcome and current definition must be distinguished.

reviews.tentative_bearing: family-benefit classification principles; current-law transposition requires text-bound comparison
reviews.note: Paragraph15 expressly applies former1408/71 and574/72 to historical dispute despite successor regulations applying since1May2010. Paragraphs28–38 classify Luxembourg child bonus from purpose and granting conditions, not domestic tax label, financing method or legal technique; statutory non-discretionary grant and enumerated risk matter. Fixed automatic bonus supporting child maintenance is a family benefit under historical1408/71. This does not make every tax concession a family benefit. Domestic historic922.50/76.88 rates are not German current parameters. Question2 on discrimination/non-cumulation is expressly unanswered, so do not promote referring-court reasoning or recited historic coordination provisions into an operative current priority rule.

reviews.read_scope: complete39-paragraph judgment and both operative holdings
reviews.tentative_bearing: divorced-family treatment and actual competing entitlement; historical1408/71 coordination, later Trapkowski adopts family-context principle
reviews.note: Paragraphs23–29 condition result on child within personal scope: national-law family membership first, then applicable household/maintenance correction, with national court verification; nonpayment of maintenance obligation does not by itself erase family membership. Divorce alone does not exclude family situations. Paragraph31 family benefits depend on family situation, not isolated claimant. First operative holding retains emigrating inactive divorced parent benefit subject to child family-member condition even if former spouse could claim. Second holding suspends only where residence-state work ACTUALLY creates competing family-benefit entitlement, and only up to that state amount. Do not replace actual legal entitlement with employment or residence Boolean alone. Austrian FLAG provisions and former1408/71 are not direct currentGerman or883/2004 rules; scope comparison still needed.

reviews.read_scope: complete60-paragraph judgment, operative part and published headnote; paragraphs24–30 read separately after tool truncation
reviews.tentative_bearing: historical non-application anti-cumulation conditions; current application fiction must be independently reconciled
reviews.note: The operative ruling rejects reduction of residence-based German benefit for foreign employment-state benefits unpaid because no required application was filed. Paragraph46 excludes1408/71Art76 because residence-state benefit was not employment-based; paragraphs49–57 reject importing Art76(2) non-application fiction into574/72Art10 by analogy. Actual formal/material entitlement is required, not merely potential foreign benefit; motive for not applying irrelevant. This is NOT a universal current883/2004/987/2009 exemption whenever money unpaid: Article60 whole-family/application rules and later Trapkowski require separate binding. Household/child personal scope includes divorced families and worker parent connection; claimant need not herself satisfy special historic German worker definition. Historical154/109.75/44.25 amounts and social-insurance definitions must not replace2025 rules. Court did not decide647/2005 equivalence underSwiss agreement because relevant text identical. Do not treat Familienkasse or FG rejected analogy as operative law.

reviews.read_scope: complete46-paragraph joined judgment, three operative holdings and published headnotes
reviews.tentative_bearing: family-benefit purpose and family-context principles adopted by later judgments; historical parenting benefit distinct
reviews.note: Paragraphs17–27 statutory objective non-discretionary childrearing payment meets1408/71family-benefit definition despite parenting-work compensation and income interaction. Not simply every fixed payment. Paragraphs29–38 worker spouse supports cross-border claim; own-versus-derived rights distinction generally does not govern family benefits, with worker-only unemployment provisions expressly distinguished. Paragraph37 requires family situation consideration; does not let any parent ignore national recipient-priority law. Article73 prevents residence/work condition that blocks abroad spouse benefit otherwise available upon remaining in payingstate. Third operative holding excludes this particular parenting benefit from79/7scope because no direct effective protection against enumerated risks; not blanket exemption from equality law.1612/68question expressly unanswered. Historic BErzGG15hours and workerdefinitions are not2025SGBIV orBEEGrules.

reviews.read_scope: complete65-paragraph judgment, operative part and published headnotes in two contiguous chunks
reviews.tentative_bearing: whole-family competing-entitlement and personal-scope interpretation, subject to successor regime comparison
reviews.note: First holding:1408/71worker status depends on insurance against at least one specified risk within identified system, not employment contract alone; paused employment does not itself end status, actual insurance membership during relevant periods requires verification. Do not encode any paid or unpaid leave as automatically insured. Second holding:574/72Art10 governs residence-based competing claims, not1408/71Art76. Residence-state employment by custodian, spouse or cohabiting partner can reverse priority even if different parent is direct benefit claimant. Paragraph62 still requires one parent actually entitled. Paragraph63 is critical: if neither parent qualifies for residence-state payment (income limit/fulltimework), no anti-cumulation, onlyArt73. Do not treat household employment as sufficient absent legal entitlement or conflate worker and payee identities. Historical Austrian14600 limit, GermanBErzGG and oldworkerdefinitions are not2025parameters. The source header identifies AdvocateGeneral opinion separately; current body is judgment, not captured opinion.

reviews.note: Applies historical574/72Art10(1)(b)(i), not1408/71Art76, to competing residence-based parentingbenefit. Paused employee remains insured under relevant socialinsurance branch, not automatically from contract. Paragraph27 separately requires residenceinstitution receiving application to pay provisional benefit pending competence dispute under574/72Art114; do not omit as merely litigation history or import directly into current987/2009 without its corresponding source. Nationalcourts rejected competence views in history not governingpriority. Judgment does not confer currentGermanBErzGG entitlement or alterKindergeldamounts.
